_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
U ngi Mdzani {player_id} eka mchezo wa Liar's Dice wa vanhu {num_players}.
Milawu:
- Loko i kuwe na wena, u nga endla yin'wana ya mintsonga mi mbirhi leyi:
  1) U endla mbilu yintsha na ntsengo wo antswa, wo tlhela wa komba (kumbe zombili) ku tlula mbilu leyikulu; hi ku komba '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) U vitana mbilu ya mahlamukelana hi ku tsala '[Call]'.

Loko u vitana:
  - Loko ku hlayiwa ka nomboro ya mahlamukelana eka taya hinkwato i tlhela i nyana ku tlula mbilu, muddabi wa mahlamukelana wa mabomu a celerwa taya.
  - Kumbe, muddabi wa mahlamukelana a celerwa taya.
Mdzani loyi a fikaka eka taya dzu i kumiwa. Mdzani wa mahlamukelana u hlula.

board.new_round:
Mudziko wu tsipa - Swiveli swa tifasi: {dice_summary}
Tifasi ta wena leti ri: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Mdzani {current_player_id} u vitana! Ku hlayiwa ka mahlamukelana ya {face_value} i {count}, leyi i nyana ku tlula {quantity}.
Mdzani {loser_id} (muddabi wa mahlamukelana wa mabomu) a celerwa taya.
call.caller_loses:
Mfiri {current_player_id} u khoma! Kuxoma kwale ka tifasi {face_value} ku ❗️{count}, ku fana na ku >= {quantity}.
Mfiri {loser_id} (yo khoma) u fela tifasi rimwe.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Ku endla xikombelo handle ko rhanga hi ku kombela.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Ntlango wo chuma swi ra hari ku ❗️'[Bid: X, Y]' ni '[Call]'. Ntlango lowu ngariweke: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Nhlayo yintshwa {new_quantity} yi le hansi ka ya sweswi {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Nxavo lowuntshwa {new_face_value} wu le hansi ka wa sweswi {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Nxavo wa yona wu fana ni lowu xavisiwaka sweswi.
bid_reason.face_range: Nhlayo ya kona yi fanele ku va exikarhi ka 1 na 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: Mutlangi {player_id} u humile hikwalaho ka ku va a nga ri na mfanelo.

outcome.win: Mfiri {winner} u winga! Vuno ra masipala: {final_ranking}
